name: nay-fiscal
description: Nay Fiscal: auditoria de notas fiscais para a Reforma Tributaria

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @nay/api" "npm run dev -w @nay/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nay/shared && npm run build -w @nay/api && npm run build -w @nay/web
scripts.start:web: npm run build -w @nay/web && npm run start:web -w @nay/api
